# Reopen is a triage signal

`customer_support.heu.ticket_triage.reopen_is_a_triage_signal` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A reopened ticket enters triage at higher priority than a new one describing the same thing.


## The heuristic

**A reopened ticket enters triage at higher priority than a new one describing the same thing.**


_Why:_ A reopen means a previous resolution was wrong and the customer has already spent patience once. The fault is not more severe, but the relationship cost of a second miss is substantially higher, and priority is the field that is allowed to carry that.
